claim_reviews.conclusion: “ketuhar gelombang mikro” is an established Malaysian Malay term for a microwave oven.

response.rationale: Both answers are semantically valid. Indonesian commonly uses “microwave” for the appliance, while Malaysian Malay has the established descriptive term “ketuhar gelombang mikro.” The English cue and sense align, the different-common-word relation is appropriate, and no false-friend contrast is present.
